items.title: ‘The pain was excruciating’: A friend in her 80s fell down her basement stairs. Could it have been avoided?
items.description: “She developed pleural effusion — fluid between the lungs and ribs — compressing her lungs and making it hard for her to breathe.”

items.title: Go ahead and get that poetry degree. Republican law won’t prevent people with humanities majors from getting student loans.
items.description: The vast majority of bachelor’s and graduate degree programs pass new rules meant to hold colleges accountable

items.title: ‘People in the U.S. need to wake up’: As a mortgage loan officer, I rejected wealthy couples due to overspending. We’re all heading for trouble.
items.description: A reader writes: “We’d better get real quick or we’re going to have a financial crisis that makes the Great Recession of 2008 look like a picnic.”

items.title: Saudi Aramco’s CEO may be too downbeat about the road to restocking global oil supplies
items.description: Some see record oil production and more alternative routes for delivery once the Strait of Hormuz fully opens.

items.title: AI chatbots recommend shopping at Walmart over just about anywhere else, analysts find
items.description: The next retail battleground could be AI recommendation engines, according to UBS.

items.title: Western Digital and Seagate shares bounce back as analysts downplay the Toshiba threat
items.description: Even if Toshiba doubles its capacity, analysts say it has a ways to go to catch up with Western Digital and Seagate

items.title: Microsoft’s blazing stock comeback isn’t even close to being over, analyst says
items.description: Microsoft looks like a winning play in an environment where investors are looking for safer bets on the AI trend, according to Melius Research.

items.title: ‘I don’t want to die on the sales floor’: I’m 67 and earn $19.50 an hour at a big-box store. When can I finally retire?
items.description: “I started taking Social Security at 66 and receive $2,410 a month. I have $214,000 in my 401(k).”

items.title: My wife never went back to work after raising our kids. Do I have to share my retirement savings 50/50?
items.description: “For 14 years I have gotten up every morning and gone to work while she has been free to pursue whatever interested her.”

items.title: SpaceX’s stock could actually be a bargain, according to this metric
items.description: The stock is expensive when valued solely by operating profit, but SpaceX is cheaper than Meta and Alphabet when you bring growth into the mix.
